This is a Direct Hire Authority (DHA) solicitation utilizing the DHA for Acq Demo Business and Technical Management to recruit and appoint qualified candidates to positions in the competitive service.

As a Program Manager at the NH-0340-4 broadband level, some of your typical work assignments may include: Serves at the Program Manager (PM) for the Missile Defense Space Enterprise Architecture (MDSEA) to include the Missile Defense Space Center, Satellite Operations Center (SOC) and Test and Integration Lab (TIL) at the Missile Defense Integration and Operations Center (MDIOC).

Will serve as the Program Manager for the Organic Ground Entry Point contract and other space-ground communication efforts.

Act as the responsible authority for the end-to-end execution, integration, delivery, and demonstration of space capabilities, such as satellites and ground systems, ensuring programs meet cost, schedule, and performance requirements. MDSEA is the critical ground command control system enabling MDA's space operations.
You may qualify at the NH 04 Broadband Level, if you fulfill the following qualifications: A.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the NH-03/GS-13 grade level in the Federal service as listed below and must meet 2 of the 3 specialized experience listed below to be qualified: Executing research and development of Acquisition systems or Major Capabilities Acquisition pathways for delivery of space capabilities.

Utilizing of acquisition authorities such as Other Transactions. Managing and integrating space and associated ground and communication systems.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

At the full performance level (GS-15) the major duties of this Program Manager position include, but are not limited to the following: Oversee and guide programs and managers to successfully achieve the organization/division mission and goals.

Plan and facilitate strategic change that are aimed at achieving and improving the quality, effectiveness, accountability and timeliness of program's accomplishments. Apply technical knowledge, analyze challenges and evaluate alternatives and identify a course of action to address specific agency/program challenges.

Strategically manage and guide planning and project management, human resources, financial and information resources. Advise management and executive leadership in the development of program policies, proposals, processes and recommendations. This position is also open to the public under announcement WO-1614-PCE-26-12998495-DE.

You must apply to each announcement separately if you wish to be considered under both recruitment methods.

Under applicable law, the employment of an individual serving a probationary or trial period automatically terminates when that period ends unless the agency affirmatively certifies, in writing, that the individual's employment should continue and that their appointment should be finalized.

In the absence of agency action to affirmatively certify continued employment beyond the probationary or trial period, such appointments are terminated. Upon completion of your probationary period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

All qualifications must be met by the closing date of this announcement-07/19/2026-unless otherwise stated in this vacancy announcement. Credit will be given for all appropriate qualifying experience.

To receive credit for experience, your resume MUST clearly indicate the nature of the duties and responsibilities for each position, starting and ending dates of employment (month/year), and the resume must reflect full and/or part-time or total number of hours worked (i.e., work 40+ hours a week, rather than indicating full-time).

If part-time, the hours must be annotated to be able to pro-rate the amount of qualified specialized experience.

To qualify for this position at the GS-15 grade level, you must possess all of the following minimum qualifications by close of the announcement: EXPERIENCE: At least one full year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-14 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the public or private sectors).

Specialized experience is experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

This experience includes activities such as: (1) managing and supervising the operations of program(s) and employees; (2) overseeing financial, human resource, and administrative operation; (3) facilitating planning and organizational change and development; (4) leading complex planning and development of strategic approaches to addressing parks, conservation and outdoor recreation issues and opportunities; and (5) facilitating outreach, meetings and relationship building with State and Federal office holders.

You must include hours per week worked. Volunteer Experience: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Major Duties: Manages a business unit consisting of the hospital functions of multiple facilities that are responsible for the intake of patients, insurance verification, billing, customer service, and performance reporting.

Controls the operational unit of the CPAC, that is designed to match to the process requirements for efficient delivery of results. Supports the overall CPAC performance and has responsibility for delivering service and revenue results that meet the expectations of the CPAC CEO, VISN and executive management.

Collects revenue for all the facilities assigned to the CPAC and must organize and control the CPAC employees located in each facility as well as the operational staff located within the CPAC.

Supports an effective compliance program that trains employees in the proper execution of their duties and motivates them to comply with all laws, rules and regulations. Preferred Knowledge/Experience: VHA Revenue Cycle, Oracle/Cerner, Managerial/Leadership experience.

Position Description/PD#: Program Manager/PD49160A Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized Financial Disclosure: Required
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 07/30/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-14 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-13. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-13 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: Using qualitative and/or quantitative methods for development and management of a major administrative program for the assessment and improvement of program effectiveness or the improvement of complex management processes and systems.

Knowledge of administrative laws, policies, regulations, and precedents applicable to the administration of one or more important public programs. Knowledge of agency program goals and objectives, the sequence and timing of key program events and milestones, and methods of evaluating the worth of program accomplishments.

Planning, organizing, and directing team work and negotiating effectively with management to accept and implement recommendations where the proposals involve substantial agency resources and require extensive changes in established procedures, which may conflict with the desires of the activity studied.

Managing a consolidated business unit consisting of the hospital functions of multiple facilities that are responsible for the intake of patients, insurance verification, billing, collection, customer service, cash management, and performance reporting.

Preferred Experience: Experience in VHA Revenue Cycle Management Proficiency with Oracle/Cerner electronic health record systems Demonstrated leadership/managerial experience For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

The purpose of the Primary Care Mental Health Integration (PCMHI) Program Manager is to provide independent clinical administration of the Primary Care Mental Health program and supervision of interdisciplinary staff who work in the Program.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional Duties include, but are not limited to: The incumbent carries out the following supervisory authorities and responsibilities: Provides direct line supervision of an interdisciplinary team of PCMHI staff, including social workers, psychologists, and prescribing providers, with anticipation of program expansion.

Plans work to be accomplished by subordinates, sets and adjusts short-term priorities, and prepares schedules for completion of work. Assigns work to subordinates based on priorities, selective consideration of the difficulty and requirements of assignments, and the capabilities of employees. Evaluates work performance of subordinates.

Coordinating services offered to veterans and their families enrolled in the program. Services include functional assessment, medications, crisis intervention, educational, individual, and group treatment, interventions specific to chronic health conditions, and care management.

Formulating, interpreting, and implementing policies and procedures pertaining to quality mental health care in PCMHI to assure compliance with internal and external performance standards. Developing effective programs and treatment strategies for PCMHI program patients.

Interfacing with other program Managers, Service Chief, Mental Health product line leadership, and VA personnel. Advising Mental Health leadership on relevant programmatic issues with recommendations for improvement in service delivery. Collaborating with other program directors and managers as a member of the Mental Health Executive Committee.

Collaborating with Primary Care executive staff as a member of the PACT Steering Committee. Maintaining effective working relationship with internal and external customer groups. Adhering to the requirements of the Master Agreement between the Department of Veterans Affairs and the American Federation of Government Employees.

The program manager will provide PCMHI-consistent care to patients within the PCMHI clinic.

This may include engaging patients through alternative technologies (e.g., telehealth, CVT to home) Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00am-4:30pm (subject to change based on facility needs) Recruitment Incentive (Sign-on Bonus): Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (Relocation Assistance): Not Authorized EDRP Authorized: Former EDRP participants ineligible to apply for incentive.

Contact raja.kadeem@va.gov, the EDRP Coordinator for questions/assistance. Learn more Pay: Competitive salary and regular salary increases. When setting pay, a higher step rate of the appropriate grade may be determined after consideration of higher or unique qualifications or special needs of the VA (Above Minimum Rate of the Grade).

Paid Time Off: 37-50 days of annual paid time offer per year (13-26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year)Selected applicants may qualify for credit toward annual leave accrual, based on prior work experience or military service experience.

Parental Leave: After 12 months of employment, up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave in connection with the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child.

Child Care Subsidy: After 60 days of employment, full time employees with a total family income below $144,000 may be eligible for a childcare subsidy up to 25% of total eligible childcare costs for eligible children up to the monthly maximum of $416.66.

Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Telework: Not Available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Applicants pending the completion of educational or certification/licensure requirements may be referred and tentatively selected but may not be hired until all requirements are met. Basic Requirements: United States Citizenship. Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy.

Education. Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: (a) The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, (b) the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature. AND Internships.

Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one- year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program. Licensure.

Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria). Grade Determinations: Psychology Program Manager, GS-14 Experience.

At least three years of experience as a professional psychologist, with at least one year equivalent to the GS-13 grade level. Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities.

In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Ability to organize work, set priorities, delegate tasks, and meet multiple deadlines. Knowledge of and ability to utilize evidence based practices and clinical practice guidelines appropriately and ability to guide staff in using these tools.

Ability to deal effectively with individuals or groups. Skill in managing and directing the work of others to accomplish program goals and objectives. Ability to translate management goals and objectives into well-coordinated and controlled work operations. Ability to establish and monitor production and performance priorities and standards.

Ability to analyze organizational and operational problems and to develop and implement solutions that result in sound operation of the program. Preferred Experience: PCMHI experience, supervisory experience. Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

The full performance level of this vacancy is GS-14. Physical Requirements: Physical aspects associated with work required of this assignment are typical for the occupation, see Duties section for essential job duties of the position. May require standing, lifting, carrying, sitting, stooping, bending, puling, and pushing.

May be required to wear personal protective equipment and undergo annual TB screening or testing as conditions of employment. Work Environment: Work is performed in an office/clinic setting with minimal risks that requires normal safety precautions; the area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated.

However, the work environment requires someone with the ability to handle several tasks at once in sometimes stressful situations.

Tasks: Manage and be accountable for a series of projects to client’s project management standards, specifically concerned with integrating internal developed components and services and with external services. Ensure regular status communication updates to ICT management in accordance with accepted reporting standards at the deadlines requested.

Maintain good working relationships with Business and ICT colleagues and external parties. Facilitate the setting up of meetings; undertake meeting minutes creation and distribution; Support the programme manager (Stream Leader) in all project dimensions when required; Follow the guidance provided by PMO, Head of Team and the Stream Leader.

Strengthen project governance implementation through chairing meetings when needed, checkpoints and boards of assigned projects, keeping stakeholders informed with up-to-date information at all times and ensuring appropriate decision making; Ensure that all relevant project management documentation, including a realistic plan and Gantt chart agreed among the project stakeholders, is in place in the project management system at any given time.

This includes participating directly in the production of project management deliverables; Ensure that the Gantt chart is always updated and showing reality; Manage the implementation of information systems to meet identified business needs, acquiring and utilising the necessary resources and skills, within agreed parameters of cost, timescales, and quality; Facilitate the production and approval of project deliverables, at the specified quality level and in accordance with the project implementation plan; Track and monitor project implementation in accordance with the scope, budget and person days specified in the project implementation documentation; Participate in identification and handling of dependencies, issues and risks affecting the project; Proactive accountability and ownership of any risks and issues identified.

Provide mitigation strategies and ensure that, when required, they are implemented or, if required, effectively escalated through the established governance (Stream leader, ICT Management, Steering Committees, Portfolio Boards, etc.); Monitor of the budget and resources available to the project, reporting to the Stream Lead (Budget holder), and support PMO undertaking steps to correct deviations either through the financial procedures or through resource management processes; Interact and communicating with client’s relevant internal stakeholders for the purpose of project implementation and monitoring, including regular project progress reporting; Supervise the delivery of products and services by external suppliers in accordance with the contracts in place, addressing and resolving issues and risks related to the relationship with those suppliers; Facilitate PMO initiatives on estimating costs, timescales and resource requirements for yearly demand cycle.

Wir sind eine der am schnellstwachsenden Digitalagenturen Hamburgs und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt neue Mitarbeiter/innen für das Projektmanagement.
Was macht die Cordes Consulting GmbH genau?
Wir sind eine Werbeagentur, welche Handwerksunternehmen durch innovative Social-Media-Strategien dabei hilft, mehr Bewerbungen von Fachkräften aus der Region zu erhalten. Wir vermarkten also mittelständische Unternehmen als attraktive Arbeitgeber in den sozialen Netzwerken.
Wenn dir analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken sowie Organisationsfähigkeit liegt und du gerne mit Kunden kommunizierst, ist diese Stelle genau das richtige für dich!
Als Projektmanager/in bist du das Bindeglied zwischen unseren Agenturkunden und unserem Online-Marketing-Team. Du organisierst Kundenprojekte und delegierst die einzelnen Teilaufgaben an die zuständigen Kolleginnen und Kollegen innerhalb des Marketing-Teams.

Pflege und Ausbau der Kundenbeziehung zu unseren Agenturkunden (renommierte mittelständische Unternehmen)
Erfassung von Kundenwünschen sowie Vorstellung und Ausarbeitung neuer Marketingstrategien
Interne Planung von Kundenprojekten (Online-Marketing-Kampagnen) und Delegation der einzelnen Arbeitsschritte
Durchführung von Strategieplanungsterminen mit unseren Neukunden zum erfolgreichen Start in der Zusammenarbeit
Regelmäßige Feedback-Meetings mit unseren Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit führen
Verantwortung und Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit von unseren Agenturkunden
Inhaltliche Fragen von Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit und zu Werbekampagnen beantworten (telefonisch und schriftlich)
E-Mail-Support für eingehende Anfragen von Bestandskunden leisten
Sicherstellung und Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit
Für unsere Stellen in der Kundenbetreuung sind keine Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen "Social-Media" oder "Marketing" erforderlich. Während unserer ausführlichen Einarbeitung lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit an Fachwissen benötigst.
Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Cordes Consulting haben möchtest, findest du diese auf www.cordes-karriere.de.
Gehalt: Senior Projektmanager - Vollzeit (m/w/d): 5.600 brutto im Monat.
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden.

Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.
Die Möglichkeit früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen: Da du eigenständig Kundenprojekte planst, Strategien erarbeitest und delegierst, kannst du schnell eigenverantwortlich arbeiten.
Ausführliche interne Schulung: Durch unser internes Schulungssystem lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit bei uns im Unternehmen benötigst.

Einen tollen Firmenstandort in der Hamburger Innenstadt mit moderner Arbeitsausstattung
Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig. Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.
Ein dynamisches Team ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.

Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin.
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Präzision.
Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch.
Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck.

The Program Manager directs an integrated Service Area resource management program supporting multiple Service Units across the Air Traffic Organization (ATO).

Manages teams through subordinate managers in workforce planning, organizational performance, employee development, staffing resource allocation, financial resource management, and organizational support functions necessary to accomplish Service Area operational objectives.

Coordinates Service Area administrative resource management activities with internal and external organizations concerning pay administration, merit promotion, Congressional inquiries, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests, and other organizational support functions affecting Service Area operations.

The work includes complex projects/programs based on the objectives.

Directs the administration of training and employee development programs, including Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Academy quota allocation, technical training, leadership development, safety training, certification tracking, and career progression planning to ensure workforce readiness and compliance with Agency requirements.

Evaluates the interrelationships of funding and resource priorities to identify shortfalls and to direct and oversee the preparation of resource appeals. Coordinates financial analysis and cost management efforts using experience applying a detailed technical knowledge of FAA and the ATO appropriations, policies, and procedures.

Applies detailed knowledge of the technical aspect of the work directed, providing strategic oversight of Service Area performance management and employees, employee recognition, and organizational effectiveness programs to improve workforce performance, mission and operational readiness, and workforce capabilities.

Plans, directs, and integrates administrative programs governing workforce planning, staffing allocations, organizational structure, organizational performance, employee development, and training to ensure organizational resources are aligned with Service Area mission requirements.

Applies a detailed knowledge of budget, human resource management and other administrative policies and procedures.

Managerial duties typically affect managers and employees for more than one organizational unit/project/program, and include: strategic planning; communicating the organization's vision and objectives; setting priorities; assigning tasks and responsibilities; monitoring and evaluating performance of organizational units, managers, and employees; coaching and developing staff and organizational capabilities; approving leave; and taking or approving corrective/disciplinary actions as appropriate.

Contacts are routinely internal and external to the Service Center. Internal contacts are with subordinates, peers, and higher level management to discuss the statuses and results of projects/programs and plan position management, staffing levels allocations and organizational structure for the future.

May represent the Mission Support Services (AJV), ATO, or the FAA externally as a primary point of contact for policies/ procedures or other project/program purposes. Has the authority, within guidelines, to make commitments for the major subdivision, to establish new policies/procedures, and to make exceptions.

Work is typically governed by established policies, procedures and mission objectives which leave considerable room for discretion. Provides guidance to subordinate managers and employees for preventing and resolving problems without the intervention of higher level management except where ATO or FAA-wide interests are at stake.

Develops and approves solutions to current and anticipated problems which cross organizational lines and disciplines. May participate in developing solutions to FAA-wide problems involving resource management issues.
Candidates must have one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to the (FV-J or FG/GS14) level that is typically in or related to the line of work of the position to be filled and which has equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the work of the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been at least equivalent to the next lower level in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Specialized experience includes: -Experience in the application of program management principles to develop plans, tasks, milestone dates, and schedules to ensure the timely coordination of activities and effective tracking of processes and costs throughout the program or project life cycle. - Experience analyzing resource requirements, developing staffing and funding solutions, ensuring compliance with agency policies and procedures. - Experience evaluating workforce and resource data, developing recommendations for leadership, and supporting strategic planning and operational readiness.

DIRECTV ’s Sales and Marketing Operations Team is seeking a Business Management 2 / Project Manager to join us. This position will support the DIRECTV for Business channel in the delivery of key strategic initiatives to drive business growth, improve customer experience, and meet the financial and operating objectives.

Project initiatives can include system and capabilities implementation, new product launches, and complex solution delivery to support all Commercial line of business. Here’s what you’ll do:
Demonstrate full accountability for success of projects by identifying input required from cross-functional areas and proactively managing action items, issues, and deliverables. Drive progress across cross-functional teams. Own cross-functional team tasks as part of project and drive execution.
Manage 2 – 3 medium to large scale projects simultaneously (in various stages of implementation). Consistently deliver results.
Lead project teams by coordinating with Sales, Marketing, IT, Customer Service, Home Services, Supply Chain, Legal, etc. as well as third party partners.
Document current and to-be business processes, provide recommendations for enhancements, and implement changes.
Gather and document detailed business requirements and develop process flows.
Provide project launch support by smoke testing, facilitating launch calls, and supporting production issues to resolution. Own and be accountable for successful delivery of all project tasks.
Confirm technical requirements drafted by IT and participate in systems discussions.
Must be able to assess the project, decisions, and processes in terms of the big picture/cross-departmental impacts as well as fully understand the details.
Develop and maintain standard project documentation including business rules/requirements, action items, agendas, minutes, and project plans.
Identify potential problems and formulate solutions that achieve business needs.
Evaluate decisions and processes to ensure they are in the best interest of customers and company goals; escalate as needed.
Perform and coordinate user acceptance testing with internal business and external partners; report all issues to IT and ensure appropriate resolution. Document and execute test cases on projects.
Prepare launch go/no go checklists and create contingency plans.
Provide project updates to management that include progress, risks, issues and mitigation recommendations. May be required to provide read out to Senior leadership team.

Experience in working with and implementation with product/engineering desired.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including a qualitative and quantitative skill set.
Ability to learn the business and become a SME for other cross-functional teams.
Experience in documenting business requirement documents, UAT test plan and UAT test cases. Experience in executing test cases and defects management.
Experience working with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Legal, Accounting, Sales, Dealer Compensation, IT, Customer Care etc.
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex issues and design appropriate solutions.
Leadership qualities, including meeting facilitation, time management, organizational skills and ability to influence others, and negotiation skills to get the job done.
Ability to synthesize information and develop creative solutions to meet business objectives.
Demonstrated success managing matrix teams; work effectively with business and technical managers.
Ability to manage heavy workload, accommodate change, and adapt accordingly. Experience delivering results in a fast moving, challenging environment.
Excellent communication skills, including ability to tailor communication to audience to achieve desired results.

SICPA donne *le rythme de la souveraineté*, permettant aux gouvernements de protéger leurs citoyens, leurs actifs souverains et leurs économies. Réputée pour sécuriser la majorité des billets de banque dans le monde, SICPA opère sur cinq continents.

Aujourd-hui, notre plateforme pour la souveraineté offre des solutions intégrées garantissant la mobilisation des recettes, les ressources naturelles, la santé, la protection des marques ainsi que la souveraineté numérique et les services publics sécurisés.

Ce rôle requiert une solide compréhension des environnements d-appels d-offres complexes, y compris les processus d-achat gouvernementaux, ainsi que les plus hauts standards de confidentialité et de professionnalisme.

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.
MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.
Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.
Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.
Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.
Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Hamburg 🚀
Aufgaben
Überblick über alle Projekte
Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.
Themen aktiv vorantreiben
Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.
Abhängigkeiten und Termine
Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".
Launches und Piloten
Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.
Schnittstelle zu Tech
Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.
Ziele und Rhythmus
Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.
Meetings und Entscheidungen
Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.
Externe Partner
Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.
Prozesse und KI
Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.
Qualifikation
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.
Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

The Program Manager will provide overall leadership, governance, and delivery oversight for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Veteran and Family Member Programs (VFMP) Modernization Portfolio.
The Program Manager will serve as the primary contractor management interface with VA leadership and will coordinate multiple concurrent modernization initiatives involving business process improvement, automation, data integration and migration, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), testing, organizational change management, and knowledge management.
The Program Manager is responsible for integrating activities across the modernization portfolio; maintaining visibility into schedule, scope, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and performance; and ensuring contractor teams deliver high-quality products in accordance with VA priorities and established governance.

Provide overall leadership and management of the contractor team and VFMP modernization activities.
Serve as the primary contractor interface with the VA COR, VA Program Manager, project managers, technical teams, business stakeholders, and other modernization partners.
Manage an integrated portfolio of concurrent modernization projects and ensure alignment with VFMP strategic and operational priorities.
Develop and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) , including milestones, dependencies, critical paths, testing activities, change management, and knowledge management.
Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, milestones, and performance objectives .
Identify, document, manage, and escalate program-level risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items .
Coordinate dependencies among automation, data integration, migration, EDI, testing, business process, KM, and change-management workstreams.
Develop and maintain program/project management plans, project charters, stakeholder/RACI matrices, risk registers, project schedules, briefing materials, and governance artifacts.
Lead program reviews, executive briefings, milestone reviews, Integrated Baseline Reviews, and Go/No-Go decision activities as required.
Establish and monitor program performance metrics and provide recommendations for corrective actions and continuous improvement.
Facilitate coordination among business SMEs, Business Architects/Analysts, data engineers, EDI SMEs, change-management personnel, knowledge-management personnel, and technical teams.
Oversee the supplemental Data Integration Project , including coordination of data engineers and analysts and delivery of an integrated data layer supporting reporting and business-rule decisions.
Ensure modernization projects incorporate appropriate testing, implementation, training, communications, change management, and knowledge transfer.
Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly program status reports and executive-level briefings.
Monitor contractor staffing, onboarding, system access, required VA training, and offboarding activities.
Provide quality oversight of contractor deliverables and ensure timely resolution of performance or delivery issues.
Maintain continuous communication with VA leadership so emerging issues are identified and addressed before they affect program outcomes.
Support transition planning and ensure program documentation, metrics, artifacts, and institutional knowledge are transferred appropriately at contract completion.

Bachelor's degree, Project Management, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
10+ years of progressive program/project management experience , including responsibility for complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
5+ years managing large-scale modernization, digital transformation, healthcare, or federal programs.

Experience developing and managing integrated master schedules, project plans, dependencies, risks/issues, performance metrics, and executive reporting.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams containing both business and technical personnel.

Programme Manager ERP Financier
Le Programme Manager ERP Financier prend en charge le pilotage global d’un programme ERP dans sa composante financière. Il veille à l’alignement entre les besoins métier, le cahier des charges et les solutions techniques mises en place, tout en garantissant la cohérence du programme à travers ses différentes phases et parties prenantes.
Dans ce rôle, vous collaborez étroitement avec les interlocuteurs clés de la finance et de l’IT, et vous assurez une communication de gouvernance claire jusqu’au niveau de direction.
Responsabilités principales
Piloter le programme ERP de bout en bout : cadrage, planification, suivi budgétaire et reporting aux parties prenantes.
Recueillir, structurer et challenger les besoins métier afin de garantir une traduction correcte des exigences business dans la solution cible.
Coordonner les équipes projet : experts finance, IT, intégrateurs et éditeurs, en arbitrant les priorités et les dépendances.

Garantir une bonne articulation entre l’ERP et les environnements existants, y compris lorsqu’un contexte mainframe fait partie du paysage applicatif.

Vous avez une expertise avérée en change management, transformation digitale et coordination de programmes complexes.
Vous avez une expérience confirmée du secteur public, idéalement dans le contexte d’une grande ville.
Vous connaissez en profondeur la comptabilité communale belge, en particulier les processus détaillés de dépenses, recettes et budget d’une grande ville.
Vous comprenez les enjeux de marchés publics et savez intégrer ces contraintes dans le pilotage du programme.
Vous faites preuve d’excellentes capacités de communication, d’un leadership naturel et d’un très bon sens de l’organisation.

Degree: architecture; or related field that included 60 semester hours of course work in architecture or related disciplines of which at least (1) 30 semester hours were in architectural design, and (2) 6 semester hours were in each of the following: structural technology, properties of materials and methods of construction, and environmental control systems.

OR Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the arts and sciences underlying professional architecture, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the architectural principles, methods, and techniques and their applications to the design and construction or improvement of buildings.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by at least one of the following: Related Curriculum: Degree in architectural engineering may be accepted as satisfying in full the basic requirements, provided the completed course work in architectural engineering provided knowledge, skills, and abilities substantially equivalent to those provided in the courses specified in paragraph A.

The curriculum for a degree in either architecture or architectural engineering covers function, esthetics, site, structure, economics, mechanical-electrical, and other engineering problems related to the design and construction of buildings primarily (but not exclusively) intended to house human activities.

The courses required for a degree in architecture generally place emphasis upon planning, esthetics, and materials and methods of construction, while the courses for an architectural engineering degree place equal or greater weight on the technical engineering aspects such as structural systems, mechanical systems, and the properties of materials.

Because of this difference in emphasis, persons with degrees in architecture may have a preference for work assignments that offer greater opportunities for them to express their artistic and creative abilities.

As a result, they may be more concerned with planning and design aspects of architecture, and persons with degrees in architectural engineering may be more engaged in aspects emphasizing technical engineering considerations.

Experience: An applicant lacking a degree in architecture must have had l year of experience in an architect's office or in architectural work for each year short of graduation from a program of study in architecture. In the absence of college courses, 5 years of such experience is required.

This experience must have demonstrated that the applicant has acquired a thorough knowledge of the fundamental principles and theories of professional architecture.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower broadband NH-02, equivalent to the next to lower grade GS-11 or equivalent in the Federal Service.

Specialized experience must include serving as a professional architect, planning and management of design and construction execution work for, and lead project teams for, substantial multi-phase new construction, renovation/repair, and improvement projects for real property facilities, including utility systems, utilizing a professional knowledge of architecture.

Knowledge of drafting techniques and skills sufficient to convey design concepts and ideas and formulate working drawings.

Knowledge of standard contracting regulations, practices, and procedures; health, safety, and environmental requirements as outlined in applicable safety standards, regulations, and/or technical orders; program planning and budgeting cycles, financial control and budget systems, and management; environmental principles, practices, procedures, laws, regulations, and current legislative issues; and work classifications and regulatory and statutory restriction on the expenditures of appropriated and non-appropriated funds.

Knowledge of automated systems and programs such as Computer-Aided Design and Drafting, information management, project tracking, and other software programs. Ability to plan, conduct, and record site/facilities surveys and inspections.

Ability to research, analyze, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, and procedures in a variety of situations; recommend timely and economical solutions; plan and organize work; coordinate the work of other architects and engineering disciplines; communicate effectively, both orally and in writing; and maintain a good working relationship.

# IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100% #
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides.

With over 50 years of experience and expertise Bachem provides products for research, clinical development and commercial application to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and offers a comprehensive range of services. Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia.

The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%
**Your tasks:**
* Own core ITSM processes - Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration and Event Management globally, ensuring SLA compliance and alignment with SOPs/ITIL.
* Define performance metrics - Set KPIs/SLAs, build dashboards, deliver monthly reports and manage escalations
* Maintain process documentation - Create and update SOPs, training materials and ensure role clarity with tracked training records
* Drive Problem Management - Run RCA processes, remediation follow-up, stakeholder communication and proactive risk identification

* Ensure CMDB data quality - Perform audits, reconciliation, issue resolution and integration with change/incident/monitoring processes
* Optimize CMDB tooling - Enhance CMDB/asset platform usage, automate via discovery tools and report on configuration compliance
* Run Event Management - Ensure monitoring coverage, correct event filtering/correlation and impact-based escalation
* Define event automation - Maintain thresholds, notifications and automated/self-healing responses
**Your profile:**
* 7+ years in IT Operations, Service Management or a related technical field, including Service Operations or Service Delivery Management
* Hands-on experience in Incident, Problem, Configuration and/or Event Management; Major Incident Management is an advantage
* ITIL Foundation certification required; ITIL Intermediate/Expert an asset.
* Strong cross-domain technical expertise across infrastructure, applications, databases, and security, with a deep understanding of their interdependencies-including modern workplace devices, application servers, and backend platforms
* Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, correlations and root causes, with the ability to lead technical RCA calls
* Excellent communication skills, translating technical detail into business- and user-friendly language
* Strong facilitation and leadership under pressure, with the ability to work across global teams and manage stakeholders at all levels
* Experience with monitoring, log analysis and service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, LogicMonitor).
**Our offer:**
* A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities
* Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction
* Company-run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf
* 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus
* Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners
* Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

Wir sind das Seniorenzentrum Engelhof in Altendorf. Bei uns finden 76 Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner ein zeitgemässes und familiäres zuhause. Auf einer geschützten Abteilung für Menschen mit Demenz stehen 10 Einzelzimmer für eine individuelle Pflege und Betreuung zur Verfügung. In unserer Tageswohnung, welche im Seniorenzentrum im Trakt Ost integriert ist, bieten wir für maximal 6 Personen einen angenehmen Tagesaufenthalt in einer betreuten Umgebung.
Für unsere Pflegeabteilung mit 24 Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und führungsstarke Persönlichkeit als:
Abteilungsleiterin / Abteilungsleiter Pflege 100%
**Ihre Aufgaben bei uns:**
* Sie tragen **die fachliche, personelle und organisatorische Verantwortung** für Ihre Abteilung und sorgen gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team für eine professionelle und herzliche Betreuung unserer Bewohnenden.
* Sie führen, begleiten und entwickeln das Pflegeteam auf Ihrer Abteilung und übernehmen die damit verbundenen Führungs-, Planungs- und Koordinationsaufgaben.
* Sie schaffen Orientierung, fördern Eigenverantwortung und sorgen für eine gute Zusammenarbeit im Team und über die Abteilungsgrenzen hinaus.
* Sie stellen die Einhaltung unserer Qualitätsstandards und internen Vorgaben sicher und entwickeln die Pflege gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team weiter.
* Sie verbinden Ihre Führungsaufgabe mit einer regelmässigen Mitarbeit in der direkten Pflege und bleiben dadurch nah an unseren Bewohnenden und am Team.
* Sie tragen die Verantwortung für den Pflegeprozess und eine fachlich korrekte Pflegedokumentation mit interRAI LTCF.
* Sie begleiten Lernende im Pflegealltag und unterstützen die Ausbildungsverantwortlichen sowie die Berufsbildner bei deren fachlicher und persönlicher Entwicklung.
**Das bringen Sie mit:**
Sie sind Pflegefachperson aus Überzeugung und gleichzeitig gerne Führungspersönlichkeit. Sie möchten nicht nur verwalten, sondern **mitgestalten und etwas bewegen**.
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachperson HF
* Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege
* Führungserfahrung sowie idealerweise eine Weiterbildung im Bereich Leadership / Teamleitung
* Eine ruhige, flexible und lösungsorientierte Art, auch wenn es einmal anspruchsvoll wird
* Klare, offene und verbindliche Kommunikation
* Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Berufsgruppen
* Empathie, Respekt und Professionalität im Umgang mit Bewohnenden, Angehörigen und Mitarbeitenden
* Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln, idealerweise Erfahrung mit interRAI LTCF
* Hohe Fachkompetenz, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
**Darauf können Sie sich freuen:**
Bei uns erhalten Sie Raum, um Ihre Ideen einzubringen und Ihre Abteilung aktiv weiterzuentwickeln. Sie treffen auf ein eingespieltes und motiviertes Pflege- und Abteilungsteam und übernehmen eine vielseitige Führungsaufgabe mit Eigenverantwortung.
Und natürlich dürfen Sie sich auf attraktive Benefits freuen, die Ihren Arbeitsalltag bereichern und Ihren Einsatz bei uns wertschätzen.

## Description ##
## Job Purpose ##
The role is aimed at owning the planning, coordination and delivery of the department-s AI initiatives, ensuring that each use case is delivered on time, within budget and to the expected quality.
## Key Accountabilities ##
* Own the end-to-end delivery of MSC-s AI use cases: planning, scheduling, resourcing and steering work from idea through to production.
* Facilitate the team-s agile ways of working - sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives - adapting the process to the team-s needs.
* Track and manage dependencies, risks and blockers across engineering, data, architecture, vendors and the business, and clear the path for delivery.
* Maintain delivery plans, status reports, dashboards and documentation.
* Provide clear, honest reporting to stakeholders on progress, timelines, scope and risk, including executive updates.
* Manage scope and expectations across competing priorities, keeping commitments realistic and delivery predictable.
* Oversee delivery budgets and timelines, keeping work cost-aware and on track.
* Coordinate across squads and external partners to keep multi-team initiatives aligned.
* Champion continuous improvement, turning retrospectives and delivery metrics into better ways of working.
* Coordinate stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of actions.

* English and Italian as primary working languages.
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Economics, Management or related fields.
* 5+ years in delivery, project or programme management roles, ideally within software, data or AI environments.
* A proven record of leading cross-functional teams to deliver complex technical work on time and within budget.
* Strong command of agile delivery with the judgement to apply it pragmatically.
* Ability to manage dependencies, risks and blockers across multiple teams and vendors.
* Ability to prepare clear status reports, action trackers, meeting minutes and executive summaries.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and senior business stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset and ability to identify issues, dependencies, risks and follow-up actions.
* Sufficient technical literacy to engage credibly with engineering teams on AI delivery (understanding of the software development lifecycle and what makes AI projects different); the role does not require coding.
* Fluency with delivery tooling such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or comparable.
* An agile or project delivery certification will be considered an advantage.
* Previous experience delivering AI, machine-learning or data-intensive projects will be considered an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI governance or regulatory regimes such as the EU AI Act will be considered an advantage.
* Background in travel, hospitality or another large-scale consumer business will be considered an advantage.
